Therefore, the Parsa between Atzilut and Beria was also nullified, and the lower two thirds of NH of Atik that were in BYA — to which the discernment of the body and soul of ZON are attached — rose, and it raised them to Atzilut, in place of the two thirds of the middle NH standing in NHY of AA; and the middle two thirds rose to the place of the first two thirds of his NHY, standing in HGT of AA. (p. 914, Item 84)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 69:1
items.html: After all the aspects of the Katnut of YESHSUT were completed, they rose as MAN to upper AVI for the inclusion of the coupling within them, for the need of the Mochin of Gadlut, as is known, in all the Partzufim. And it is known that every illumination comes only from Ein Sof, and therefore, at the time when YESHSUT rose as MAN to upper AVI, AVI likewise raised MAN to their own upper one, and that upper one to the one above it, until the Rosh of AK, which receives the aspect of new light from Ein Sof upon the MAN raised to it, and there comes out a level of ten Sefirot upon this MAN, called Mochin, or the drop of the coupling and MAD; and these Mochin descend from Partzuf to Partzuf until they come to their first place, namely in the first Partzuf, which was the first to raise MAN, for whose sake the light of Ein Sof descended. Hence every drop of birth and new emanation is attributed to AB SAG of AK, which are the first to receive the light of Ein Sof.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 69:2
items.html: And therefore, when these Mochin reached Atik, and it too coupled from the aspect of these Mochin in its Yesod and Atara, all the Parsaot in Atzilut that came by force of the second restriction, namely by force of the rise of the bottom Hey in Einayim, as is known, were then breached; and then the Yesod of Atik was breached as well, since the screen of the Yesod of Atik makes AA into a Partzuf separate from it, on account of the rise of the bottom Hey to Einayim. (As above, page 726, Act 8) And now AA and Atik became one Partzuf.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 70:1
items.html: The ascent of MAN of Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna to AVI (as above in answer 156) joined AVI and Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna into one Partzuf, in which Yisrael Saba is included in the discernment of Aba, and Tevuna is included in the discernment of Ima, in the way explained above, page 670, Sub Header, ‘Adam HaRishon’; see there. For all the discernments explained regarding the ascent of ZON to the chamber of AVI, in order to beget the soul of Adam HaRishon, apply likewise to the ascent of Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna to the chamber of AVI, in order to beget ZA. And it was explained there that ZA becomes the discernment of Aba, and the Nukva the discernment of Ima, and the soul of Adam HaRishon was born from the discernment of ZON, and not from the discernment of AVI. So it is here too: although Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna were included and became the discernment of AVI, nevertheless ZON were born from Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna and not from AVI. And this is what the ARI is precise about above (p. 945, Item 148), that the place of the coupling and pregnancy is in the head of Tevuna; see there. (p. 943, Item 146)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 71:1
items.html: After AA and Atik became a single Partzuf, and the NHY of AA rose to the place of the NHY of Atik, meaning to the place where AVI stand, AVI are now found in the phase of below the Chazeh of AA, which rose to the Peh of his Rosh, where the Hassadim are revealed. And this is the rule in every place where NHY rise to HGT: HGT gain the phase of the revealed Hassadim of NHY. And see in Pri Etz Chaim, in the Introduction to the Gate of Shabbat, Chapter 5. (Item 920, item 89)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 72:1
items.html: You already know the difference between the Partzufim of AK and the Partzufim of Atzilut: the Partzufim of AK are the aspect of the five Partzufim of the light of Hochma, while the Partzufim of Atzilut are the five Partzufim in the illumination of Hochma within Hassadim, and not Hochma itself. This is because the matter of the five Partzufim of Atzilut is only to complete the aspect below the Tabur of AK, which is the aspect of MA and BON, namely ZON, whose entire correction is only the aspect of the illumination of Hochma within Hassadim, like the aspect of ZON of direct light. You also know that there are two bestowals to Keter: from HGT it is Hochma, and from NHY it bestows Hassadim, as above in Answer 149. Therefore ZAT of Atzilut cannot come out from the coupling of kissing, which is the bestowal of Hochma, but must come out from the aspect of NHY, which is the coupling of the Yesodot, from where comes the bestowal of Hassadim. Yet they also need the coupling of kissing, since ZON cannot come out in the bestowal of Hochma without true GAR preceding them, just as a body cannot come out without a head. For once the light of Hochma is revealed in GAR, ZON can receive the illumination of Hochma from them. (947, Sub Header, “And Now”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 73:1
items.html: For that drop of MAD is the drop of the coupling of AB that brings down the bottom Hey from Einayim and cancels the Parsaot, which comes from Moach Stimaah, which is AB and the Hochma of AA, as is known. And it is known that AB illuminates only down to the Tabur and nothing at all from the Tabur downward. Hence, these MAD are discerned as the phase of the name HaVaYaH missing the bottom Hey, which indicates the phase of illumination of below the Tabur, which is missing in it. (Item 928, item 106)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 74:1
items.html: For the filling of Alephin is the phase of ZA, and the filling of Heyin is the phase of the Nukva; and since the phase of the Ibur [impregnation] is only from the level of NHY, which is the level of Malchut, therefore the MAN are the phase of the filling of Heyin. (Page 929, Item 110).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 75:1
items.html: They are from the filling of AB, the filling of MA and the filling of BON. And the filling of SAG is missing from them, because SAG serves here only as a passageway. The reason is that the GAR of SAG are covered Hassadim, whereas here they are revealed Hassadim in the illumination of Hochma, which is drawn from the level of AB. (Page 928, Item 106).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 76:1
items.html: The HBD of AVI are two names Ehyeh in the filling of Yods; the HGT of AVI are two names Ehyeh in the filling of Alephs; and the NHY of AVI are two names Ehyeh in the filling of Heys. And in the same way the HGT of AA are likewise divided, from the Peh [mouth] to the Tabur. (Page 930, Item 114).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 77:1
items.html: See answer 162.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 78:1
items.html: Because MAD is the level that descends from above downward for the purpose of clothing; and since there is here only the level of Nefesh, it is therefore in the filling of Heys, for nothing is revealed here but the level of Nefesh. (Page 931, Item 115; Page 943, Sub Header, “and what”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 79:1
items.html: The measure of coarseness is discerned only in the MAN that ascend from below upward. When the place of the coupling is in Bina, it brings out the level of Bina; when it is in the Einayim, it brings out the level of ZA; and when it rises to Galgalta, it brings out the level of Malchut. Therefore, since what is here is the discernment of Ibur [impregnation], the coupling is made in the place of the two names Ehyeh of Yods, which is the discernment of the Keter that is in the HGT of AA, standing in the place of the Garon [throat]. It therefore brings out the level of Malchut. (Page 939, Item 115).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 80:1
items.html: For although Hochma, which is Mocha Stimaa, was corrected within herself in the manner of male and female and brought Bina, which is the Garon [throat], outside, this does not mean that separate male and female were made in Hochma Stimaa itself, as in AVI who are below the Garon. Rather, it means in the discernment of the Nukva that is in his Guf [body] — that is, in the discernment of the screen of the Rosh [head], as is the practice in the Partzufim of AK as well. Only, since this took place here in the place of Hochma, Bina came out below the discernment of the Rosh. But this in no way touches Mocha Stimaa itself, which is found above this screen, and therefore the male and female are in the aspect of a single Partzuf, like the Partzufim of AK, and there is in them only one YHV. This is not so with AVI who are below the Garon of AA, who are found beneath the screen of the Rosh: there AVI became two Partzufim separate from one another, each of which has male and female in its own Guf. For there is a great difference there between Abba and Ima, since Abba came out in the secret of the Hesed at the tops of the shoulders of AA, while Ima came out from the discernment of the light of the Garon; and Ima is also in a posterior position toward the light of Hochma. They therefore became two distinct Partzufim, and they are two names Ehyeh and not a single name, as is Mocha Stimaa. (Page 935, Item 123).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 81:1
items.html: See answer 167.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 82:1
items.html: The first is the sorting of the dross found in his MAN, which ascend from BYA, and this is done by Abba, in the secret of the 32 paths of Hochma. The second is the sweetening of the bottom Hey in the first Hey, in the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, and this is done by the five Gevurot of Ima, in which ZA is included at the time of his mingling in the coupling of Ima. See above in answer 17. (Page 958, Sub Header, “and with”).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 83:1
items.html: The source of the drop of the coupling that brings the bottom Hey down from the Einayim and annuls the Parsas is AB of AK, since it is above the second restriction. For the second restriction began from SAG of AK, as is known, and therefore the illumination of AB annuls the second restriction and all the screens that are drawn from its side.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:1
items.html: The first cause is the rise of MAN of YESHSUT to AVI for the need of the Mochin of Gadlut, at which time all the upper Partzufim likewise raise MAN up to AB SAG of AK, as above in Answer 156.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:2
items.html: The second cause is the coupling of AB SAG upon the MAN raised to them, and a new light was drawn to them from Ein Sof, and there came out there a complete level upon this MAN, called Mochin, or MAD. For the aspect of the screens and coarseness included in the records are called by the name MAN, and the level of the ten Sefirot that comes out upon the MAN is called by the name MAD. And the illumination of this MAD descended until it reached Atik and its Nukva of Atzilut.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:3
items.html: The third cause is the descent of the drop of MAD in Atik down to the coupling of Yesod and Atara, which annuls all the Parsaot of Atzilut that were made from the root of the rise of the bottom Hey in Einayim, namely the Parsa in the “belly and its innards,” which is likewise the aspect of the membrane beneath the Moach Stimaa, and the aspect of the screen of Yesod, and the aspect of the Parsa of the ending of all Atzilut, standing between Atzilut and Beria.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:4
items.html: The fourth cause is the annulment of the Parsaot: through the annulment of the Parsa between Atzilut and Beria, the lower thirds of Atik rose from BYA, together with the aspect of Rosh and Guf of ZON, which are the secret of Vav and a dot, to the place of the middle thirds of Atik, where the NHY of AA stand; and also, through the annulment of the Parsa in the “belly and its innards” of Atik, Atik and AA united and became one Partzuf.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:5
items.html: The fifth cause is the return of AA and Atik to one Partzuf, which brought about four things: First, that the NHY of AA became the aspect of the NHY of Atik, through which they rose to the place of its HGT, where the NHY of Atik stand; so the Yesod of AA is found to end equally with the Yesod of Atik, namely at the place of the chest of AA. Second, that this whole place, which was in the aspect of HGT, meaning in covered Hassadim, was turned and became the aspect of revealed Hassadim, since the NHY of AA now took hold of this whole place from the Peh to the chest. Third, that the Yesod of AA now comes to the Yesodot of AVI, since, through the Yesod of AA becoming the Yesod of Atik ending at the place of the chest of AA, that is the place of the aspect of the Yesodot of AVI, as above in Answer 153. Fourth, that the Rosh and Guf of ZON, which were attached to the Yesod and Atara of Arich Anpin, rose together with this Yesod and Atara to the place of the Yesodot of AVI, namely to the place of the chest, where the Yesodot of AVI now clothe upon the Yesod of AA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:6
items.html: The sixth cause is the drop of MAD of AB of AK, which descended also to the Moach Stimaa of AA, so that AA too coupled in the secret of palate and throat, called the coupling of kissing, from where it reached AVI as well, and they too coupled in the coupling of kissing; and then they lowered the bottom Hey from the Einayim of YESHSUT, and they received new Mochin and NHY, namely that YESHSUT raised their fallen AHP, and with them also the aspect of Rosh and Guf of the portion of ZON attached to their AHP. It is thus found now that all the portions of ZON have already risen, since the NHY of AA raised with them the Rosh and Guf of its own portion, namely from the secret of Vav and a dot; and the new AHP of YESHSUT raised the Rosh and Guf of the portion of ZON from the aspect of their portion from the time of Nekudim. And all three aspects of the Rosh and Guf of ZON now stand in the three Yesodot of AA, Aba, and Ima, clothed one within the other. You already know that Yisrael Saba is included in Aba, and Tevunah is included in Ima, as above in Answer 157.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 84:7
items.html: The seventh cause is that the drop of kissing of Aba, which is AB, descended to his Yesod, which is the aspect of 32 NTH, and descended and refined the dross that was in the 320 sparks, which are the 32 Malchuts, and brought them down as refuse, and selected from them only 288 sparks, which are the secret of the white in the offspring, since they are the aspect of the very essence of the Sefirot of ZA, from the aspect of the line and a half on the right, meaning that the left line is absent from them, which is the aspect of the bottom Hey mixed into the ten Sefirot, as above in Answer 135. The reason is that Aba had already brought down every aspect of the Malchuts within him, which are of the aspect of judgment and dross, upon which there is no aspect of a screen, so that all the Sefirot of ZA are found entirely clean of the aspect of Malchuts; therefore it is considered the aspect of the right line of the ten Sefirot alone, without any coarseness of the bottom Hey — and this is the secret that Aba gives the white within it. And Ima also couples from the aspect of her Katnut, namely from the aspect of the bottom Hey in Einayim remaining in her from the time of Katnut, and then Ima gives the illumination of her five Gevurot to the 288 sparks, so that the bottom Hey of the clothing remaining in the 288 sparks is thickened by the five Gevurot of Ima, and passes through all the ten Sefirot of ZA, and makes in them the line and a half on the left. And the aspect of the coupling of Aba, which corrects the line and a half on the right, is called the first day of the days of absorption; and the aspect of the coupling of Ima, which corrects the line and a half on the left, is called the second day of the days of absorption. And after this, AVI couple with one another, and then these lines of AVI join together, which is the aspect of the third day of the days of absorption.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 85:1
items.html: The essential aspect of ZON, which are of the phase of Vav and a point, are attached to the Yesod and Atara of Arich Anpin; and the Yesod of Arich Anpin is clothed within the Yesods of Aba and Ima. (Page 923, Item 98).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 86:1
items.html: The purification of the dross is through Aba, and the correction of the lines is through Ima.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 87:1
items.html: Since there were three partners in the ZAT of Nekudim in the emanation of ZON, which are the ZAT of Nekudim: the NHY of AK and the NHY of AVI. Hence, they are joined together in the phase of AHP, which are: the AHP of Keter of Atzilut, which are Atik and AA, which are the phase of the inner NHY of AK, which is also the Partzuf of the Keter of AK. And the AHP of AVI and Yashsut, which are returned to a single Partzuf, are in the place of the AVI of Nekudim at the time of their Gadlut.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 88:1
items.html: Even though NHY of AA rose to HGT, and HGT too rose to GAR, and likewise the middle thirds that were clothed within HGT of AA also rose to GAR, and so on — nevertheless, they are all considered together: both the discernments that rose to HGT, and the discernments that had previously been in HGT, just as they are now found together at the time of the coupling for the impregnation of ZA. For they all participate in his emanation, as written in Part 11. And the reason is that there is no absence in the spiritual, and the whole matter of change of place said of the spiritual is nothing but a matter of addition to its previous discernment, as is known. (p. 919, Item 86)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 89:1
items.html: They rose to the phase of the GAR of their own, and became there new GAR of AVA, and the GAR of their own rose still higher, for this is the rule, that it is impossible for any ascent to happen to a lower Partzuf, unless all those above it ascend first. As is known in the secret of the ascents of the Sabbath. (Item 920, item 87)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 90:1
items.html: It was already explained above in Answer 175 that, since there is no absence in the spiritual, all the phases that were previously in HGT are also found there, which is the secret of the inclusion of all the phases of NHY and HGT, and of Atik and AA from the time they were two Partzufim, and so on, all of which participate in the emanation of ZA. And accordingly, the ARI says that the HGT of AA are still clothed within the inner NHY of AA, even though, from another perspective, they have indeed already risen to the phase of GAR, as mentioned above. (Item 919, item 86; Item 920, item 87)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 91:1
items.html: Since AA and Atik became one Partzuf, the NHY of AA are found in the place of the NHY of Atik, namely in the place of his own HGT, and the HGT of AA are in the place of the HGT of Atik, namely in his own GAR. (Page 920, Item 87).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: For after the drop of MAD reached the eyes and nose, and from there to the Yesod and crown of Atik, the Parsa within the innards of Atik was nullified — the outer one, between AA and Atik as separate Partzufim — and the two became one Partzuf. Thus HGT of AA rose to the place of his GAR, where HGT of Atik had stood, and with them rose also the discernment of the upper thirds that are clothed in these HGT, which contain also the discernment of the Yesod of Atik; therefore his screen departed from there. However, the ARI does not wish to elaborate on Atik, as is known; therefore he abbreviates and says that it cannot bear so many lights — meaning, since the lights of NHY of AA, which are revealed Chasadim, came to this place, the place of the Yesod of Atik was clarified [as being] further up, in the HGT that had been there before, which are in GAR of AA. (p. 920, Item 89)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 93:1
items.html: For besides the difference of covered Chasadim that exists between AVI and Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna, as is known, there is yet another difference in this matter between Aba Ila’ah and Ima Ila’ah themselves. For the root of Aba Ila’ah — that is, his two and a half Chasadim — remained sealed within the Yesod of Atik. But the roots of the Gevurot of Ima Ila’ah went out from the Yesod of Atik and were revealed in the HGT of AA, as the ARI writes in Etz Chaim, Gate 14, end of Chapter 1; see there. And on this his words here revolve: that after the breaking open of the Yesod of Atik, the two and a half Chasadim of Aba were also revealed outward, and now there is no longer any difference between Aba Ila’ah and Ima Ila’ah. (p. 920, Item 89)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 94:1
items.html: For in truth Atik was corrected to be the root for the light of Hassadim, and AA to be the root for the light of Hochma. However this is only from the aspect of the division of the five Partzufim of Atzilut into twelve Partzufim. Then Atik bestows Hochma upon AA, to the root of its part from the chest and above, which stands in the Peh of AA, as is known. But Atik itself became the root for the light of Hassadim, and it bestows from the Yesod and above the aspect of covered Hassadim to AVI, as above in Inner Observation, Part 8. And when they are in this manner, AA too does not bestow Hochma, for all bestowal is from the aspect of the HGT of the Partzuf, and since its aspect of HGT is in covered Hassadim, how could it still bestow Hochma from it? Therefore, when AA wishes to bestow Hochma upon the Partzufim, it must become one Partzuf with Atik, at which time the HGT of AA become the aspect of the NHY of Atik, and it can then bestow the illumination of Hochma through them. And you must remember the rule stated above, that wherever NHY rise to HGT, the HGT itself becomes the aspect of revealed Hassadim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:1
items.html: You already know that the upper one always fits its coupling to the measure of the MAN, namely the records of the lower one, that rise to it for the inclusion of the coupling. And it is known that there are two aspects in the records: one is the refined light within them, which is the aspect of direct light, the aspect of the GAR of the records, which remained in Atzilut; and there is also the aspect of coarse light, which are the aspects of the coarseness and the reflected light, called sparks, which are the aspect of the light of Hassadim and HGT, and were able to descend with the vessels to BYA. And the vessels themselves are the NHY in all of them.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:2
items.html: Therefore, in order to correct the vessels, AVI need to clothe in the screen of the aspect of NHY of Katnut, namely the aspect of the Yesod of Tevunah, at the time when they were divided into themselves as a Partzuf separate from upper Ima. And in order to correct the sparks, AVI need to clothe in the screen of HGT of Katnut, which stands at the place of their chest, which is the place of the cut between Ima and Tevunah. You already know that the Yesod of Katnut stands at the aspect of the chest. And in order to correct the aspect of the lights in the records, which are the aspect of GAR, they need the aspect of the GAR of upper Ima from the time of Katnut, from when she was lacking the fiftieth upper gate, as above in Answer 129, see there. And by this the records of direct light, which are the aspect of GAR, are corrected.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:3
items.html: Addendum to Answer 88 Regarding what was said there about the distinction between the male and female Partzufim of Atzilut, one must understand well the two lower Partzufim, MA and BON, of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:4
items.html: Now, the ARI explained them in Etz Chaim, Gate 5, end of Chapter 1, and this is his language: In the internality of AK there is one HaVaYaH, and from its four letters come out four Havayot that are revealed outside of AK, and these are the HaVaYaH of AB, SAG, MA, and BON, and they are in the forehead, AHP; and the fact that the HaVaYaH of BON precedes the HaVaYaH of MA is the secret of the Tefillin of Rabbeinu Tam, and the secret of “a female shall surround a male.” This concludes his words. So the ARI considers the two worlds, Nekudim and Atzilut, to be BON and MA of AK. And these words need explanation, since nothing remained from the world of Nekudim except the GAR that Atik of Atzilut took, while the ZAT broke, front and back; so how did the ten Sefirot of Nekudim become BON of AK, and moreover become the root for its MA, in the secret of “a female shall surround a male”?

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:5
items.html: However, one must remember here the rule that all the lights in the lower one are found, in their essence, in the upper one above it, and in the lower one itself they are only the aspect of a small branch, as is known. Therefore every lower one comes out from the aspect of the lack that is in the upper one, and also completes the lack within it. For those lights that the upper one bestows upon its lower one had already fixed their place in the upper one itself, and therefore they complete it. Hence, after the refining of the Guf of the Partzuf of Keter of AK, when the lights departed from its vessels, AK emanated AB and SAG, so that they would return to fill the lights for the vessels of its Guf; and since AB and SAG were completed at the Tabur, and completed nothing at all to fill it in the whole place from the Tabur down to the ending of its legs, it therefore returned and emanated the ten Sefirot of Nekudim from its Tabur and below, from the lights of the Nikvey Einayim. The aspect of their Rosh and Toch came out in the GAR of Nekudim, in the complete fullness of the correction of the lines; but in the ZAT, only the aspect of the illumination of vessels was reached, from the aspect of the look of the eyes at the AHP below the Shibolet HaZakan, which are the lights of NHY without a correction of the lines, as is known. Because of this, only the lower third of the Tifferet of AK, from its Tabur to the ending of Tifferet, was corrected with three lines; but all its ZAT of NHY, from the ending of its Tifferet and below, remained with only two lines, without the deciding force of the middle line there. It is then considered that AK was completed by itself, through its emanation of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, only in the aspect of the TNHY of the female alone, namely in two legs, in the lights of Nefesh, lacking a middle line. And although the Katnut of ZAT also broke, face and back, in Nekudim, this does not affect at all the aspect of their root that remained in AK itself for its own completion, as you know from the reason that there is no absence in the spiritual. It is therefore considered that Shabbat was born first, since AK received completion for its NHY from the aspect of a daughter and a female, and this correction remained fixed in it permanently.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:6
items.html: Therefore AK emanated the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, in order to correct the ZAT of its NHY. And it is known that the entire ten Sefirot of Atzilut are the aspect of the ZAT of the NHY of AK, which did not receive corrections in the world of Nekudim, as above. Therefore AA begins to clothe from the Peh of RADLA and below, which is below the ending of the Tifferet of AK, since RADLA clothes the entire place of the lower third of the Tifferet of AK, and RADLA does not join Atzilut, as is known; rather, AA is considered the Keter of Atzilut. So the entire world of Atzilut clothes only the ZAT of the NHY of AK, and therefore the five Partzufim of Atzilut are considered only the HGT NHY of AK alone. And it is known that all five Partzufim of Atzilut came at first in the secret of the impregnation of three within three, through which they received the aspect of the joining of the measure of mercy with judgment, since the bottom Hey that was attached to Yesod rose and was included in Tifferet, which is the Bina of the aspect of Hesed and Bina of Hassadim, as is known. It is thus found now that the correction of the lines was also completed in the Toch of the ten Sefirot of NHY of AK, namely in the HGT of its NHY. In such a way that, when GAR of Atzilut, namely AA, AVI, and YESHSUT, were emanated, the GAR of the middle line of this Toch were corrected; and when ZAT of Atzilut, namely ZON, were corrected, then the ZAT of the middle line of the Toch of the ten Sefirot of NHY of AK were corrected. Therefore the entire ten Sefirot of Atzilut did not come for AK except to correct the middle line of the Toch of the ten Sefirot of its NHY, called the male Yesod of AK, or Hadar. GAR of Atzilut corrected in it the upper Hadar, and ZAT corrected in it the lower Hadar. And this is what completes the TNHY of AK in the aspect of the five Partzufim of AK, in the secret of the male within it, and it is considered a product of its AB, since it came through the coupling of AB SAG. And you should understand that all of this discussion is from the aspect of the ten Sefirot of Atzilut that are fixed in the NHY of AK itself, on account of the lights of the lower one being found essentially in its upper one. Now you should understand well the rule, that every Partzuf is composed of the five Partzufim GESMB, so that every aspect takes from the corresponding Partzuf in the five Partzufim of AK. You should also understand that the female Partzufim of Atzilut, being entirely only from BON of AK, have no deciding force of a middle line in the Toch of their NHY, since even in AK they are lacking. But all the male Partzufim of Atzilut have the aspect of a Toch in their NHY, since they receive from the corresponding aspect from MA of AK, which has the deciding force of a middle line in the Toch of its NHY. You should also understand that MA is caused by BON, in the secret of “a female shall surround a male,” since in the particulars of AK itself, BON came out first, and it completed the GAR of NHY; and the MA within it is a branch and product of BON. And BON is considered the aspect of surrounding in relation to MA, by virtue of being its upper one — for the upper one is considered surrounding in relation to the lower one beneath it, as is known.
